author: Zephyr I
title: Pure-dilation d=5 + pre-LSTM 1x1 bottleneck (ratio ∈ {0.5, 0.75, 1.0}), single-step LN
abstract: Test a lightweight 1x1 conv bottleneck before the ConvLSTM (keep ConvLSTM at 64ch) on the strong pure-dilation d=5 single-step LN baseline. Hypothesis: reduce recurrent input dimensionality without harming capacity. Sweep bottleneck_ratio ∈ {0.5, 0.75, 1.0}. BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.5, 0.75, 1.0]),
    }

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    dilation: int = 5
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

class DilatedBottleneckPreLSTM(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 1.0
    attn_temp: float = 1.0
    dilation: int = 5
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        # Dilated CNN backbone
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_1, dilation=self.dilation)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_2, dilation=self.dilation)(x)

        # Pre-LSTM 1x1 bottleneck (reduce input channels into the LSTM)
        bn_ch = max(8, int(self.cnn_features_2 * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        x_proj = nn.Conv(bn_ch, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                         kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)

        # Init/reset recurrent state
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda C: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, C), dtype=x.dtype)
            h, c = zeros(self.conv_lstm_features), zeros(self.conv_lstm_features)
        else:
            h, c = rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            h, c = h*m, c*m

        # Single-step ConvLSTM on projected features; hidden size remains 64ch
        (h2, c2), y = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features)((h, c), x_proj)
        rnn_state = {'h': h2, 'c': c2}

        # Single-head attention pooling
        logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                         kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        attn = nn.softmax(logits.reshape((B, -1)) / self.attn_temp, axis=-1)
        z = jnp.einsum('bi,bic->bc', attn, y.reshape((B, 64, self.conv_lstm_features)))

        # Policy/Value heads
        z = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); z = nn.relu(z)
        pol_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); pol_h = nn.relu(pol_h)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(pol_h)
        val_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); val_h = nn.relu(val_h)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(val_h).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return DilatedBottleneckPreLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=int(hparams['cnn_features_1']),
        cnn_features_2=int(hparams['cnn_features_2']),
        conv_lstm_features=int(hparams['conv_lstm_features']),
        bottleneck_ratio=float(hparams['bottleneck_ratio']),
        attn_temp=1.0,
        dilation=5,
    )
